reason: I get abayas off Shein and TikTok Shop for like $20 to $30, so $45 for an everyday one and $75 to $80 for a thobe is a lot for me, even with 15% off for one day. I'm not driving out to Westchase on a Sunday just to look at stuff I can probably find cheaper online.
objection: Embroidered thobes, bishts and jalabiyas sound really Gulf/Arab-style, and the everyday abayas might just be plain black. I'm not sure there's anything there that fits my style, and I don't want to pay boutique prices to find out.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing TikTok videos of colorful, trendy pieces that actually look like my style, with everyday abayas around $30 or a real clearance or sale rack.
